_comment: Every external link and site-wide setting lives here. Change it once, it updates everywhere. Empty strings do not display anywhere on the site — leave a value blank rather than inventing one.

site.name: The Sunlit Wanderer
site.tagline: Relaxed portrait photography in Dayton, Ohio and surrounding areas.
site.title: The Sunlit Wanderer — Portrait Photography in Dayton, Ohio
site.metaDescription: Relaxed, outdoor portrait photography for families, high-school seniors, maternity and couples in Dayton, Ohio and surrounding communities. Sessions from $150.
site.serviceRadiusNote: Sessions are generally within about 30 miles of Dayton. Farther locations can be arranged individually and may include a travel fee, which is always discussed before booking.

booking._comment: ShootProof handles booking, contracts, questionnaires, invoices and client galleries. All three URLs verified working September 3, 2026.

contact._comment: Messenger is primary. The m.me link must ALWAYS render as a button labeled 'Message me' — never as a visible URL. The Google Voice number is the only number published anywhere.

social._comment: Facebook URL needs to be confirmed on a phone before launch — the page has no username, so the numeric-ID form is the only option. Instagram and TikTok are blank until the handles are confirmed; blank means the icon simply does not render.

analytics._comment: No analytics or tracking at launch, by requirement §47. This flag exists so the decision is visible rather than forgotten.

policies._comment: Canonical wording for the booking and weather policies. These are echoed in faq/general.json and copy/prepare.md — if you change a policy, change it in all three places. The ShootProof contract is the legally binding version; this is the plain-English one.
policies.paymentAtBooking: Nothing is due when you book.
policies.paymentDue: Payment in full is due by the date of your session, invoiced through ShootProof.
policies.rescheduling: With at least 24 hours' notice you can reschedule or move your session. Short-notice illness and genuine emergencies are handled case by case — just let me know as soon as you can.
policies.weather: If weather makes a session impractical and I'm the one calling it, rescheduling never costs you anything.
policies._contingency: If two no-shows or unpaid sessions occur, revisit a 10% nonrefundable booking fee — $15 / $27.50 / $47.50. ShootProof supports full payment upfront, a percentage of the session fee, or payment due by the session date. A flat $25 across all tiers is not possible.
policies.salesTax: No sales tax collected. Determination: this model delivers digital files through ShootProof only, with no physical product sold or shipped.
